evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Experiments show that loyalty is not guaranteed by general capability or existing alignment, with measurable EIL and MIU gaps under zero-shot evaluation, while our trained 8B models reduce per-response leakage in single-turn exchanges by 31-44pp and improve task utility, evidence faithfulness, and decision accuracy by up to 11pp, 49pp, and 29pp, respectively.
